description:
Finding: provider HTTP errors store raw provider response bodies in public error details. Error.to_map/1 sanitizes transport output, but raw error structs may still leak Slack/GitHub user content if logged or rendered directly.

Scope:
- Introduce a public/private error detail boundary or sanitize and bound provider bodies at construction time.
- Keep enough provider error context for debugging status, provider reason, retry_after, and compact message.
- Ensure tokens, secrets, user message content, GitHub file contents, issue bodies, and Slack profile/message payloads are not retained in public details by default.
- Update tests for Jido.Connect.Http.provider_error/2 and provider client invalid response paths.

Primary files:
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/provider/http.ex
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/error.ex
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/sanitizer.ex
- apps/jido_connect_github/lib/jido_connect/github/client.ex
- apps/jido_connect_slack/lib/jido_connect/slack/client.ex

Acceptance:
- Public error structs and Error.to_map/1 expose bounded sanitized details only.
- Provider raw response bodies are either absent, redacted, or kept only in an explicitly private/debug-only field that is not returned by default.
title: Sanitize provider error detail boundary
